summary: Building blocks of public pages. Several are flagged as generic when used out of habit; each is fine when it answers a question the visitor has and carries real content.

entries.what: The first screen shows the real product: a screenshot, a demo or the output.
entries.build: A real screen at a readable size, cropped on what matters.

entries.what: A headline with a primary and a secondary button side by side.
entries.use_when: When the two actions serve different visitors (try and see a demo).
entries.avoid_when: As a default (flagged as generic): one clear action is usually stronger.
entries.build: Primary filled, secondary as a text link or outline.
checks: deslop tells: hero with two buttons

entries.what: A small pill above the headline announcing news or a category.
entries.use_when: Real news with a link (a launch, a release).
entries.build: A link to the news, removed when it is old.

entries.what: A row of three or four big figures with a label each.
entries.use_when: Real, sourced, recent figures that matter to the visitor.
entries.avoid_when: Rounded or invented numbers (BRD-01); opening the page with them.
entries.build: Tabular figures, the source in a note.

entries.what: How it works in three numbered steps.
entries.use_when: When there really are three steps the visitor must understand.
entries.avoid_when: Numbers on things that are not a sequence (flagged as generic).
entries.build: Steps with a real visual each.
Monochrome, same optical size; a marquee only with a pause.

entries.what: Quotes from real customers with name, role and photo.
entries.build: Specific result in the quote, a link to the source when public.

entries.what: A switch on the pricing page shows the price per month or per year.
entries.build: Sliding pill indicator, the saving in money, the same price at checkout.

entries.what: Plans or products compared feature by feature.
entries.use_when: Three or more plans, or a product against alternatives (honestly).
entries.build: Sticky header row, ticks with text for screen readers, the recommended plan marked.

label.fr: Bouton d'action collé en bas sur téléphone

entries.what: The main action stays at the bottom of the phone screen while scrolling.
entries.avoid_when: When it covers content or other fixed buttons.
entries.build: Safe-area padding, hidden while the keyboard is open.

entries.what: A last section that repeats the main action at the end of the page.
entries.avoid_when: Short pages where the action is still visible.
entries.build: One action, a sentence that answers the last doubt.

entries.what: The next card shows partly at the edge, which says there is more.
entries.avoid_when: Essential content hidden in later slides.
entries.build: About a quarter to a third of the next card visible; scroll-snap; arrows on desktop.

entries.what: A short form to receive news by email.
entries.use_when: Editorial sites, brands with regular news.
entries.build: One field, what and how often in one sentence, double opt-in, consent not pre-ticked.

entries.what: Address, map and opening hours on one block.
entries.build: Static map image linking to a maps app (no heavy embed on load), hours in a table, LocalBusiness structured data.
